# Al Murqab Law Office (مكتب المرقاب للمحاماة)

> Qatari law firm in Doha, Qatar, providing legal consultation and representation before the Qatari courts, in Arabic and English, for individuals and companies. Practice areas: criminal law, civil law, commercial law, corporate law, administrative law, real estate law, labour law, family law, arbitration & dispute resolution.

## Firm facts
- Name: Al Murqab Law Office — مكتب المرقاب للمحاماة
- Address: Salwa Road — Al Jazeera Petrol Station, Doha, Qatar
- Phone and WhatsApp: +974 7190 0190
- Email: info@almurqablaw.com
- Hours: Sunday – Thursday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM · Urgent consultations available 24/7
- Languages: Arabic, English
- Founder: Abdullah Al-Khawar
- Website: https://almurqablaw.com (Arabic at /ar, English at /en)

## Practice areas
- [Criminal Law](https://almurqablaw.com/en/practice-areas/criminal) · [القانون الجنائي](https://almurqablaw.com/ar/practice-areas/criminal): We provide professional criminal defence across all matters, protecting our clients' rights from the moment of arrest and questioning through to final judgment, to the highest standards of competence and integrity under Qatari law.
- [Civil Law](https://almurqablaw.com/en/practice-areas/civil) · [القانون المدني](https://almurqablaw.com/ar/practice-areas/civil): Our team specialises in complex civil disputes, providing robust representation for individuals and companies in compensation claims and civil actions before the Qatari courts.
- [Commercial Law](https://almurqablaw.com/en/practice-areas/commercial) · [القانون التجاري](https://almurqablaw.com/ar/practice-areas/commercial): We provide end-to-end commercial law services, helping companies and traders resolve disputes and structure agreements in line with Qatari commercial law and the demands of a modern business environment.
- [Corporate Law](https://almurqablaw.com/en/practice-areas/corporate) · [قانون الشركات](https://almurqablaw.com/ar/practice-areas/corporate): We accompany companies through their entire legal life cycle — from incorporation and structuring, through contract drafting, to restructuring, mergers, and acquisitions — under Qatari company law and international governance standards.
- [Administrative Law](https://almurqablaw.com/en/practice-areas/administrative) · [القانون الإداري](https://almurqablaw.com/ar/practice-areas/administrative): We represent individuals and companies in disputes with government and administrative bodies, providing the expertise needed to challenge administrative decisions and protect rights before Qatar's administrative courts.
- [Real Estate Law](https://almurqablaw.com/en/practice-areas/real-estate) · [القانون العقاري](https://almurqablaw.com/ar/practice-areas/real-estate): We provide specialised advice and representation across every aspect of real estate and construction in Qatar — from contract drafting and title registration through to dispute resolution before the competent courts.
- [Labour Law](https://almurqablaw.com/en/practice-areas/labor) · [قانون العمل](https://almurqablaw.com/ar/practice-areas/labor): We provide comprehensive employment law services to both employees and employers, ensuring full compliance with Qatari labour law in a balanced workplace that upholds rights and obligations alike.
- [Family Law](https://almurqablaw.com/en/practice-areas/family) · [قانون الأسرة](https://almurqablaw.com/ar/practice-areas/family): We handle family matters with the utmost sensitivity and complete confidentiality, working to achieve the best outcomes for our clients across all personal status matters under Islamic Sharia and Qatari legislation.
- [Arbitration & Dispute Resolution](https://almurqablaw.com/en/practice-areas/arbitration) · [التحكيم وتسوية النزاعات](https://almurqablaw.com/ar/practice-areas/arbitration): We provide arbitration and mediation services domestically and internationally, representing clients under the leading international arbitration rules to reach fast, effective settlements at the lowest cost.

## Legal guides (English)
- [Challenging an Administrative Decision in Qatar: Grievance Deadlines](https://almurqablaw.com/en/insights/administrative-decisions-appeal-qatar): Challenging an administrative decision in Qatar: eligible decisions, 60-day deadline, grievances, and the Administrative Circuit under Law No. 7 of 2007.
- [Nafaqa Maintenance in Qatar: Wife and Child Support Explained](https://almurqablaw.com/en/insights/alimony-nafaqa-qatar): Nafaqa maintenance in Qatar under Family Law No. 22 of 2006: wife and child support, how courts assess it, interim maintenance, changes and filing a claim.
- [Commercial Agency in Qatar: Registration, Termination and Rights](https://almurqablaw.com/en/insights/commercial-agency-qatar): Commercial agency law in Qatar under Law No. 8 of 2002: who can be an agent, registering an agency, termination and compensation, and resolving disputes.
- [100% Foreign Ownership in Qatar: A Guide to Law No. 1 of 2019](https://almurqablaw.com/en/insights/foreign-ownership-company-formation-qatar): 100% foreign ownership in Qatar under Law No. 1 of 2019: which sectors are excluded, how MOCI approval works, investor guarantees, and mainland vs QFC.

## الأدلة القانونية (العربية)
- [الطعن في القرار الإداري في قطر: التظلم والمواعيد والدائرة الإدارية](https://almurqablaw.com/ar/insights/administrative-decisions-appeal-qatar): الطعن في القرار الإداري في قطر: القرارات القابلة للطعن والمستثناة، وميعاد الستين يوماً، وأثر التظلم، والدائرة الإدارية وفق القانون رقم 7 لسنة 2007.
- [النفقة في قطر: نفقة الزوجة والأولاد وكيف تقدّرها المحكمة](https://almurqablaw.com/ar/insights/alimony-nafaqa-qatar): دليل النفقة في قطر وفق قانون الأسرة رقم 22 لسنة 2006: نفقة الزوجة والأولاد، ومعايير تقدير النفقة، والنفقة المؤقتة، وزيادتها أو تخفيضها، ودعوى النفقة.
- [الوكالة التجارية في قطر: التسجيل والإنهاء وحقوق الوكيل والموكل](https://almurqablaw.com/ar/insights/commercial-agency-qatar): الوكالة التجارية في قطر وفق قانون الوكلاء التجاريين رقم 8 لسنة 2002: شروط الوكيل، وتسجيل الوكالة، والإنهاء والتعويض، ونزاعات الوكيل والموكل.
- [تملك الأجانب للشركات في قطر بنسبة 100%: دليل القانون رقم 1 لسنة 2019](https://almurqablaw.com/ar/insights/foreign-ownership-company-formation-qatar): تملك الأجانب للشركات في قطر بنسبة 100% وفق القانون رقم 1 لسنة 2019: الأنشطة المحظورة، وخطوات الموافقة، والحوافز، والفرق بين السوق المحلي ومركز قطر للمال.
